title: C2: Smith, An Introduction to Gödel's Theorems
source_inspected_version_and_primary_acc: Smith, [*An Introduction to Gödel's Theorems*](https://logicmatters.net/igt/pdfs/GodelBookLM.pdf), second edition, Logic Matters corrected reprint, August 2020. [Author page](https://logicmatters.net/igt/), [corrections](https://logicmatters.net/igt/pdfs/CorrectionsLM.pdf).
passages_and_planned_use: Chapters 9–17: induction, Q, PA and representation; 19–20: syntax/proof coding; 24–27: diagonal lemma, Rosser, enumerable theories and truth; 31 and 33–35: second incompleteness/derivability conditions; 38–43: partial recursion and machines. Actual selected readings include 90–94, 107–112, 113–116, 119–121, 185–189 and 258–261; other locations were verified from the contents. Page 116 supplies a compact CRT/beta proof with a boundary-case correction.
